trust_decision.summary: A session caller may read contributor-scoped data (profile incl. miner hotkey/alphaPerDay/taoPerDay/usdPerDay) only for its own GitHub login (static tokens unrestricted), decided by requireContributorAccess in the HTTP layer and its twin in the MCP class; MCP output additionally strips sensitive keys by name.

landing_point.why: Advisory names the 'profile endpoint'; it is the only /v1/contributors/:login/* route without the requireContributorAccess call its neighbours have (src/api/routes.ts:1539, src/api/routes.ts:1548, src/api/routes.ts:1555).

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tools/call gittensory_get_contributor_profile via POST /mcp (registered src/mcp/server.ts:350-356)
every MCP tool result via toolResult (src/mcp/server.ts:1074-1085)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/mcp/server.ts:1088-1096 (redactSensitiveForMcp key regex, applied to all MCP tool output); MCP tool itself at src/mcp/server.ts:693 is a second transport but is named by the advisory

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the MCP profile tool is gated to the caller's own login, the per-day earnings are the caller's own data (and the HTTP route still returns them per the OpenAPI schema), so extending the MCP redaction list looks unnecessary.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Static-token callers and a session reading its own login must still get the profile; MCP output must keep credibility while dropping per-day fields; the HTTP profile response still documents alphaPerDay/taoPerDay/usdPerDay, so stripping them from the HTTP mapper or schema would break the self/static-token contract.

O6_input_shapes: case-differing login vs session actor (lowercased compare, src/api/routes.ts:2681, src/mcp/server.ts:598)
financial keys nested at any depth / inside arrays of MCP payload (recursive filter, src/mcp/server.ts:1089-1094)

O7_producer.where: src/signals/engine.ts:1108-1125 copies hotkey and alphaPerDay/taoPerDay/usdPerDay into profile.gittensor (fed from src/gittensor/api.ts:233-235 and cache src/db/repositories.ts:1421-1423)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a /v1/contributors/:login/<x> route (e.g. evidence or fit) that returns buildContributorProfile output without requireContributorAccess
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Contributor routes are added one by one in this block and each repeats the guard by hand; the profile route itself is proof one was forgotten.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a local-branch MCP slice that echoes context.profile (or gittensorSnapshot) into its data while relying on the key-name redaction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: analyzeLocalBranch already loads the full profile and snapshot via loadContributorFastContext (src/mcp/server.ts:1033-1062); adding them to a slice output is a one-line convenience change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: extension pull-context returning the PR author's contributorContext.profile to an extension session that is not the author
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Route already loads the author's full profile for another user and only uses derived values; exposing it 'for the side panel' is a plausible feature addition, and its extension-session gate looks like access control.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the stdio MCP package's own sensitive-term redaction regex lacking PerDay keys (second implementation of the redaction)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Separate package with its own wallet|hotkey regex; a maintainer updating server.ts would not touch it.

O9_family: missing authorization / IDOR on contributor-scoped read (CWE-284) plus sensitive-field exposure

O10_build.toolchain: Node + npm, Hono on Cloudflare Workers, vitest 4 (also @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers config)
O10_build.project_tests: test/integration/routes-errors.test.ts (contributor guard 403s, near line 163) and test/integration/api.test.ts (MCP tool calls with stubbed fetch); fetch is stubbed via vi.stubGlobal

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add requireContributorAccess to the HTTP profile route only (copying its neighbours) and leave the MCP tool and the MCP redaction list unchanged.
